name: The University of Manitoba
description: The University of Manitoba was founded in 1877. It is located in Winnipeg, Manitoba, Canada. It is the state's largest university. The University of Manitoba has more than 130,000 students, approximately 13% of whom are international students. It is a university preferred by students from over 100 countries. There are instructors from many parts of the world. The campus is in Canada. It is one of the suitable places. It is a research-intensive university. Classes are small to be more interested in students' education. It is the university where students receive the most awards in Western Canada. It has 2 main campuses, Fort Garry and Bannatyne. The University of Manitoba is in the top 400 according to Times Higher Education and in the top 650 according to QS in the world rankings.
